title: Sequoia among leads of Anthropic's $65B Series H

sources.quote: Anthropic has raised $65 billion in Series H funding led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia Capital, valuing the company at $965 billion post-money.
It also includes $15 billion of previously committed investments from hyperscalers, including $5 billion from Amazon.

explain: Sequoia was one of four leads of a $65 billion funding round for Anthropic at a $965 billion valuation. The amount shown is the whole round, and $15 billion of it is money cloud giants such as Amazon had already committed; Sequoia's own share was not disclosed.
